findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 3 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Computer Science Board shape (8 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 12 questions numbered 1-12; by section: 3.1 1, 3.2 11.

Covers the benefits of OOP, classes and objects with __init__ and self, the three access levels with name mangling, encapsulation with a private balance, single inheritance with overriding and super(), multiple and multilevel inheritance, compile-time style overloading (default arguments, *args and conditional logic, with a worked trace), runtime polymorphism by overriding, the two types of polymorphism compared, and one program using encapsulation, inheritance and polymorphism together. None repeats the chapter exercise. Every program was run in Python 3; the outputs (and the error shown) are the real ones. Book correction followed: a private member has two underscores.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
